# Wick - Automatic Tyre Equalisation System (ATES)

> Wick is India's leading provider of automatic tyre inflation and equalisation systems for commercial vehicles. Our flagship product TyreRakhshak uses ATES (Automatic Tyre Equalisation System) technology to maintain optimal tyre pressure in real time.

## Key Facts

- **Company**: Wick (est. 2021, Faridabad, Haryana, India)
- **Product**: TyreRakhshak ATES (Automatic Tyre Equalisation System)
- **Problem Solved**: Automatic tyre pressure management for trucks and trailers, preventing blowouts, extending tyre life by 20%, reducing fuel consumption by 2%+
- **Target Users**: Fleet owners, transport companies, commercial vehicle operators in India
- **Coverage**: All of India (Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Chennai, and more)
- **Contact**: office@wick.co.in | +91-9721601500
- **Address**: House Of Wick, 33B, NIT, Faridabad, Haryana 121001

## Products

- **TyreRakhshak ATES**: Automatic Tyre Equalisation System that continuously monitors and adjusts tyre pressure for trucks and trailers. Key benefits: 20% longer tyre life, 2%+ fuel savings, 144 hours downtime saved annually, blowout prevention.
- **Truck Tyre Pressure Monitoring (TPMS)**: Real-time tyre pressure monitoring system for commercial vehicle fleets.

## How ATES Works

ATES connects to the vehicle's air compressor and uses a network of manifolds, control valves, and rotary joints to automatically inflate or deflate tyres while the vehicle is running. The system maintains optimal pressure based on load and road conditions, preventing dangerous blowouts and uneven tyre wear.
